predictions.sink_summary: importlib.import_module() dynamically loads and executes Python modules. When name is a file path (.py extension), it adds the directory to sys.path and imports the module name without extension.
predictions.guard_summary: Limited validation: checks if file exists and has .py extension before path manipulation. No validation of template names for package imports. No authentication or authorization on D-Bus methods. Path manipulation occurs before import.
predictions.risk_pattern: Remotely controllable D-Bus method parameter flows through minimal validation to dynamic module import with sys.path manipulation, enabling arbitrary Python code execution.
used_variable_sources: template parameter to AddTemplate() D-Bus method
predictions.context_summary: The load_module function handles both file paths (with .py extension) and template names. For files, it manipulates sys.path to import from arbitrary directories. The function is called from D-Bus exposed methods and test utilities.
